controls.evidence: The scheduler raises exceptions every ten minutes and escalates them: past its date the owner is reminded, 3 days later every admin. Invoices go for their IRN as soon as they are issued. Depreciation posts itself at month end.
0 open, each with an owner and a date; 0 closed, each with a resolution or a reason for waiving it. Every step is kept against the exception.

GSTINs are checked for format, check digit, state and PAN; the same GSTIN twice is refused and a repeated PAN or name is flagged; a vendor's invoice number cannot be entered twice; credit limits, negative stock and cash limits are enforced as set.

Perpetual inventory from 2026-11-01: every sale posts its cost to Cost of Goods Sold and out of Inventory, every stock purchase goes to Inventory, and month end brings Inventory into line with the stock valuation.
Invoices needing an IRN are registered automatically on issue; an outage is retried, a refusal becomes an exception with the IRP's reason. Registration goes through the built-in stand-in.
controls.gap: Connect a GSP with NIC credentials (Settings → Integrations) for live IRNs.

controls.evidence: Customers 15, 30, 60 and 90 days past due are raised to their account owner. Reminders go on days -3, 0, 15, 30, 60, 90 from the due date. Invoicing a customer 90 days in arrears is warned about; credit limits warn.
Bills due within 7 days, and overdue ones, are raised for whoever pays them. 2 approval rules on bills and payment batches.
Every MSME bill is tracked against its 15 or 45 days from day 30, raised as an exception, escalated as the deadline nears, with s.43B(h) disallowance and MSMED interest worked out.
4 assets in use on the register, with Schedule II and income-tax block depreciation. Depreciation posts itself at each month end.
Imported statements are matched automatically: 3 active rules, deposits naming an invoice, and lines equal to a payment already entered. The rest are suggested for one-key matching.
Every change is kept with who, when, from where and the values before and after; nothing in it can be edited or deleted (MCA Rule 11(g)). A reason is required for every change.
Five roles plus custom roles, checked on the server. Nobody approves what they submitted. Paying a bill you entered or approved is refused. 2 approval rules active.
10 budgets with budget-against-actual from the journal; a 13-week cash forecast from open invoices, bills, cheques, recurring entries and payroll.

Cash forecast with each customer's own payment behaviour, anomaly detection over the journal (round sums, weekend and late-night postings, duplicate payments, amounts far from a party's usual) and a risk score for each customer.
0 contracts and certificates in the document library, with expiry dates; 0 files attached to vouchers and records.
Every unexpected error is kept with when, where, the stack and how often, under a reference the user is shown; each is closed with its cause and fix.
Last backup 1 hours ago against a 24-hour recovery point; last restore drill 2026-11-06.

Passwords hashed with Argon2id, at least 10 characters with mixed case and digits, none of the last 5 reused; lockout after failed attempts; two-step sign-in optional; idle sign-out after 60 minutes; bank numbers, PAN and Aadhaar not yet encrypted (no FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY on the server).
controls.gap: Require two-step sign-in and set an idle sign-out.

controls.evidence: Figures are summed in the database on indexed (book, account, date) columns; the dashboard is cached until the next posting. Measured at 1 lakh vouchers: trial balance 1.4 s, P&L 1.4 s, balance sheet 1.9 s (npm run bench:reports).
Any customer holding more than 25% of receivables, or owing more than their credit limit, is raised as an exception to their account owner.
